audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Swain, Swain, Skill, Skill, Swain, Skill, Skill while the content layer and packet levelChart both read Lissandra, Skill, Lissandra, Lissandra, Lissandra, Lissandra, Swain. Every row disagreed. The lane was also labelled TRICKY 7/10 against a 54.57% win rate.
audit.why: Swain has no dash; his all-in needs Nevermove to land on the return, and Lissandra's root and claw punish the whiff on a 12s timer. What he actually wins is the late game through Ravenous Flock stacking, which is exactly what the content chart says.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved onto the content values with the whys rewritten row by row, and diff set to EVEN 5.5/10 with the matching tone.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic anti-assassin template and phases[6].why claimed late Lissandra opens every fight, contradicting the content layer's Swain-scaling verdict on the same row.
audit.why: At 6 the real interaction is that Frozen Tomb's self-cast makes you untargetable and invulnerable, so a Swain draining you gets nothing for the duration. Late, soul stacks and sustained healing outlast a burst rotation.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around self-tombing inside the drain; phases[6].why rewritten to state Swain's scaling, matching win[6].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and the page never states the single most punishable thing about Nevermove.
audit.why: Nevermove roots on the RETURN of the wave, not on the way out — the danger is behind you, and Swain can then pull everything rooted toward him. It is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s. Vision of Empire is 22s with 5500-7500 range and grants him a Soul Fragment on champion hit; Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s.
audit.corrected: Named all three with real numbers and the return-root behaviour.

audit.why: report[8] already calls for early anti-heal, which is what the missingInteractions 'needs-antiheal' rule requires against Ravenous Flock.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second invitation' after a wasted Demonic Ascension.
audit.why: Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s at every rank.

notes: All seven full-layer sides disagreed with the content layer and the packet chart; the full layer was moved onto the content values as one atomic group and every why that changed verdict was rewritten in the same proposal, so no win[N] flips were required. diff moved from TRICKY 7/10 to EVEN 5.5/10 against a 54.57% win rate; Swain's carry rating was left at 7.5/10 because he genuinely takes the late game. UNVERIFIED, left untouched: the content layer states in spikes[1].text, whys[4] and mid that Frozen Tomb 'interrupts' or 'cleanly interrupts' Demonic Ascension. Riot's text calls Demonic Ascension a transformation that persists as long as he drains, not a channel, and the kit file carries no channel flag on it. I could not confirm from the kits that hard CC cancels the form, so I did not rewrite those three fields — but I also did not build any new advice on the claim. My phases[4].why instead uses the interaction I can source: self-cast Frozen Tomb makes you untargetable and invulnerable, so a Swain draining you gets nothing for its duration.
